The source already claims this theorem; this is external source-aware review, not a new recursion construction or exponent.

Exact domain: fixed L>=2, odd q>=3, N>=1, `b=q^(N*N)`, `H=b^(w-1)`, `A0=T*(L*H)^d`, `R0=H*R_body`, positive canonical w/T/R_body, finite d>=0, arbitrary complete bit packets. Two compiled child sites and a complement-bit leaf. Retained isolated machine/router/shape and numeric resource contracts remain premises. Physical LEFT/BASE markers, encoded entry packets and owned blank growth are preprovided; their preparation time is outside the invocation and is not zero. K_entry is space only. Natural-root A/R production and outer descriptors are excluded.

Both sites generate grants from their current live A/R and immutable H. Full child coordinate `h*R+r` retains older ancestors. Global output protection precedes all child retirement/pop; phase, saved head offsets and raw unary depth restore the exact parent. Time uses `V0*sum_(j=0..d)(2/L)^j`; L2 keeps `(d+1)V0`. Space uses the active-chain geometric sum, with erased/physical000 backing still charged. BILL-NOTES gives fewer-than64 aggregate helper groups per site without dropping a K factor; source `C_time=1e8*(K+bitlength(b)+1)`, `C_space=1000*(K+bitlength(b)+1)` retain explicit primitive/entry premises. No isolated94V whole-tree price.
